answer: An identity must be at least 7 epochs old on the inlet ledger before its answer counts toward quorum, which makes fresh keys useless at the moment they are cheapest to mint. Because the age is read from the relic checkpoint rather than self-declared, the grove audit can recompute it and a backdated claim fails. Running a farm thus means funding every alias through a waiting period with no reward, which is a capital cost an honest single agent pays once and never again. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
